package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// GetCourse fetches course data.
type GetCourse struct {
	Courses    repository.CourseRepository
	CourseI18n repository.CourseI18nRepository
}

// Handle returns course by slug.
func (uc GetCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, slug string, lang string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	course, err := uc.Courses.GetBySlug(ctx, slug)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return course, nil
}

// HandleByID returns course by id.
func (uc GetCourse) HandleByID(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	return uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID)
}

// HandleByIDWithFields returns course with selected fields.
func (uc GetCourse) HandleByIDWithFields(ctx context.Context, courseID string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return uc.Courses.GetByIDWithFields(ctx, courseID, f)
}
